preserved_failure.finding: Optional capability HTTP request could outlast the call deadline and prevent opening a healthy WebSocket. Reproduced with zero sockets after15s; fixed with separate1.5s discovery budget and cancellation.
preserved_failure.verify_conclusion: cancelled before packaging to correct the reproduced availability issue

source_notes: The capability fault-injection case preceded telemetry-only changes; the final eight-browser statistics case records the current engine, SDK adapter and panel. Backend sources are unchanged.

preserved_statistics_failure.finding: The new relay path omitted effective UI statistics and counted the upload ceiling as seven screen sends. Fixed with source-bound SDK RTP measurements and one shared upload plus actual direct senders.
preserved_statistics_failure.verify_conclusion: cancelled before packaging to preserve effective quality indicators
